svg.title: Five properties of a correct path
svg.desc: Test 4: from S at (0, 0) to D at (3, 0) on a 4 by 4 grid with (1, 0) and (1, 1) blocked. Left, the BFS path around the wall, 7 steps, with badges showing properties 1 to 4 holding: the first step is next to the start, the last step is the destination, every step is next to the one before, and no step is blocked. Middle, the five properties; the fifth, steps equal the Manhattan distance, is only checked on an open grid. Right, Manhattan's path goes straight down through blocked (1, 0) and fails property 4.
svg.text: first step: next to the start
every step: next to the one before
Any path with all five is correct,
whichever of the shortest ones it is.
